4363.title: Watchdog leaves a pending runtime turn
4363.rootCauseOneLine: The watchdog emits a warning without resolving the pending start, so runtime admission keeps rejecting subsequent turns.
4363.proposedFix: Define cancellation/fencing and queued-message retry policy before releasing pending admission.
4363.caveats: Real Claude missing-start cause and live UI/queue behavior remain unverified.
